name: Mamba 2.8B

release_date.note: arXiv submission of the paper; the original state-spaces/mamba-2.8b repo was created 2023-12-03

params.note: derived from config; equals the Hub's safetensors count

mixers.note: inner width 5120 (expand 2), state 16 per channel, causal conv kernel 4, dt rank 160

stack.note: one Mamba mixer per block; no attention and no separate FFN

steps.label: in_proj 2560 -> 2x5120; x branch: causal conv k4, SiLU, selective scan (state 16); z branch: SiLU gate; out_proj 5120 -> 2560

specials.name: short_conv
specials.what: depthwise causal convolution, kernel 4, on the x branch before the scan

specials.name: tied_embeddings
specials.what: output head reuses the embedding table

paper.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces

code.note: MambaBlock: norm, mixer, residual add; MambaMixer in_proj/conv1d/x_proj/dt_proj/A_log/D/out_proj; lm_head tied

hfapi2.note: safetensors total 2,768,345,600; no licence tag on the -hf copy

count.note: Vd + L*(in_proj d*2di + conv di*4+di + x_proj di*(r+2N) + dt_proj r*di+di + A di*N + D di + out di*d + norm d) + final norm

figure_links.author: Albert Gu, Tri Dao
figure_links.title: Figure 3 of the paper: the Mamba block next to H3 and the gated MLP

unknowns.context_length.value: a recurrent model has no position limit; config sets no max_position_embeddings
unknowns.attention.heads: Mamba-1 has no heads: the scan runs per channel
unknowns.ffn.hidden_dim: the block has no separate FFN; the Mamba mixer's gated branch plays that role
unknowns.ffn.config_activation: config hidden_act silu belongs to the Mamba mixer (conv output and gate), not to an FFN

notes: The -hf repo is a transformers-format copy of the original checkpoint; licence taken from the original repo.
